component.name: Limonada
component.summary: Browse, search, vote and comment on Lemmy

description.p: Limonada is a native desktop client for Lemmy, the federated link aggregator. It talks to any Lemmy instance over the v3 API.

It browses a feed with sort and listing controls, scopes to a single community, renders posts and their full comment threads with Markdown, and shows a post's picture at the best resolution the instance offers — including AVIF, decoded in pure Rust with no system codec.
Searching covers posts, comments, communities and users. Signing in to an instance adds up and down voting on posts and comments, and writing comments and replies. Browsing needs no account.
